710540101.text: Stop! Please stop! Let us explain!

710540102.text: Aren't you guys just a bunch of Treasure Hoarders? Just turn yourselves in. There's nothing to explain around here!

710540103.text: #Millelith Squad Leader Yanbo of The Chasm District, at your service. It's an honor to meet you, {NICKNAME}.

710540104.text: And your... most eminent flying companion.

710540105.text: Hey, hey, hey, it's Paimon to you, mister!

710540106.text: Haha... I apologize. I'm very sorry, but I think there's been a small misunderstanding here.

710540112.text: *cough* Well, and you're not wrong to say that this area was indeed one of the Treasure Hoarders' lairs.

710540113.text: After the workers were dismissed, those weasels wormed their way in here... At first, they were just mining, smuggling some Glazed Sand Crystal, and playing hide-and-seek with our patrols.

710540114.text: But they would grow bolder as time went on, even breaking into and occupying the old warehouse that the miners left behind. They even used the tools there to make their own cheap little trinkets to sell! *sigh* Breaks my heart every time.

710540116.text: Such rough-hewn trinkets can only be used to cheat first-time visitors to Liyue or some ivory-tower scholars. And I'll bet that they'll try to get them on the market using lower prices, too, perhaps even try undermining some legitimate brands.

710540117.text: It's not like they've got any brand power themselves, right?

710540118.text: That's true. I suppose it's a joke in poor taste to think that they'd make good Mora off this...

710540119.text: That's why we came here and took care of the Treasure Hoarders who originally held this position, before disguising ourselves as them and lying in wait... Well, that was a while back now.

710540120.text: We had managed to ascertain thus far that one of their leaders is in contact with a branch of the Fatui, and that they may be preparing a transaction involving dangerous items.

710540110.text: Haha, I apologize for the lack of explanations. In fact, we thought that you were saboteurs yourselves.

710540111.text: Well, from a certain point of view...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the surrendered Treasure Hoarder Member
Meet up with Yanbo in front of the smuggler's camp

710540401.text: I think hitting the <color=#00E1FFFF>alchemy camp</color> first will do the most damage to them.

710540402.text: Good. We'll put a stop to whatever they're brewing.

710540501.text: I think hitting the <color=#00E1FFFF>weapons stash</color> first will make our lives easier.

710540502.text: Sure. They'll find themselves disarmed soon enough, mark my words!

subQuests.subQuestName: Clean out the Treasure Hoarder logistics camps

710540701.text: That was amazing. Thanks for your aid. Right, here's your reward.

710540702.text: Woohoo, Mora! Eh? When did you change your clothes?

710540723.text: When you start fighting... Well, I mean, that's not important. But we had to change our uniforms, lest you ended up sending us flying again in the heat of battle.

710540703.text: The Millelith thanks you for your aid, as always. Ah, and as per our contract, feel free to look around and see if there's anything that you need.

710540704.text: Well, other than the things that we've impounded, of course.

710540706.text: Well, it was thanks to you that things went quite so well.

710540709.text: Uh, what I mean to say is... As long as you don't take illegal shortcuts like these bandits, we won't come knocking at your door.

710540710.text: Hmph. That's not the kind of people we are!

710540712.text: *sigh* Back on topic... People like you who can use the elements really are a force to be reckoned with, regardless of whether you mean to do good or ill...

710540713.text: A mission that we would have needed weeks, even months to accomplish, was but child's play to you... If turned to evil, such abilities could produce outsize damage at a very small price.

710540714.text: That's why I don't really rue the fact that I don't have a Vision.

710540715.text: I have seen people who dedicated their lives to seek superhuman power, only to become tools and puppets for others to use as they pleased. Do you think that was worth it?

710540717.text: Those without Vision-based powers make up the vast majority of humans, and those who can truly understand and protect them are, similarly, ordinary folk.

710540718.text: As an ordinary person, I am proud to be among those who can protect the many.

710540719.text: Even if someday, Visions ceased to be given out, and even the adepti who defend Liyue Harbor were to pass away... I would not abandon this post of mine.

710540720.text: Ah, um, sorry... I spoke too much. I didn't take up too much of your time, did I?

710540721.text: Alright, we've got checks to do and contraband to mark out, so I guess we'll cut the chit-chat short here.

710540722.text: Once again, I'd like to thank you on behalf of our comrades. May the rest of your journey be smooth-sailing. While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail!

710540708.text: Of course, you were assisting the Millelith... I mean, you were apprehending smugglers with the aid of the Millelith. How could we ever put you in prison?

subQuests.subQuestName: Clean out the Treasure Hoarder logistics camps

710540801.text: Don't worry, we'll move these foodstuffs away as soon as possible.

710540802.text: It's up to you now. Good luck!

subQuests.subQuestName: Clean out the Treasure Hoarder logistics camps

710540901.text: Their alchemy equipment is rather amateurish... Most of the tools were rendered unusable after just a few bumps as we were transporting them.

710540902.text: We'll get these things impounded and cleared out as soon as possible. As for the rest down there, we'll need your help.

710541001.text: Their bows were actually quite well-maintained. That said, they're ours now. I wonder how many years they'll get just for illegal ownership of these...

710541002.text: We're done on our end. The rest is up to you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the Treasure Hoarder smuggling crew at the larger camp

710540201.text: You're here. Wonderful. I knew you would be willing to help out.

710540202.text: The Treasure Hoarder smugglers should be undertaking their transaction with the Fatui in the large encampment in the east. They have also set up three smaller camps along the way.

710540203.text: According to the information provided by the contact, these are the <color=#00E1FFFF>cooking quarters</color> to the southeast, the <color=#00E1FFFF>weapon stash</color> further east, and the northeastern <color=#00E1FFFF>alchemy camp</color>. If we are able to take these three camps by surprise, we should be able to cut off their supply line.

710540204.text: Thanks to the previous incident with the Jade Chamber, we've had few patrols in this area, so they've had their fun so far, so much so that they've slackened their guard significantly. This is our chance to strike.

710540205.text: It's just that... Our misunderstanding earlier has left us with only enough support to secure one encampment. But if you need it, we will assist all the same.

710540301.text: I'd suggest that you hit the <color=#00E1FFFF>cooking quarters</color> first.

710540302.text: Alright. We'll move their food supply off with all haste.
